_comment: Rich per-table metadata for SAP SQL agent. Used for enhanced descriptions, sql_hints, and join context.

AUFK.description: Internal order master data (SAP CO). Tracks costs, revenues, or activities for projects, maintenance orders, marketing campaigns. Primary key: aufnr.
AUFK.business_meaning: Internal orders for project cost tracking, maintenance, marketing, internal cost collection. objnr links to COEP/COSP for actual/planned costs.
example_questions: Show internal orders by profit center
Which profit center has the most orders?
AUFK.sql_hints: AUFK: use aufnr (order number), ktext (description), prctr (profit center), kostl (cost center), objnr to join COEP/COSP for costs. Group by prctr, kostl, bukrs, or EXTRACT(YEAR FROM erdat) for time analysis.

BSAD.description: Customer cleared items (Accounts Receivable). Paid/cleared customer invoice line items. BSAD = historical cleared receivables (invoice was paid).
BSAD.business_meaning: Cleared (paid) customer invoices. Use for: total payments by customer, revenue collected, payment timing, cash discounts. Join KNA1 on kunnr for customer name.
BSAD.sql_hints: BSAD: dmbtr/wrbtr = amount; augdt = clearing date; kunnr = customer. SUM(dmbtr) GROUP BY kunnr for revenue by customer; GROUP BY prctr, kostl, bukrs; EXTRACT(YEAR FROM augdt) for time. Join KNA1 on kunnr for name1.

BSEG.description: Accounting document segment (FI line items). Every financial transaction creates entries. Customer (koart D), vendor (K), GL (S), material (M), asset (A).
BSEG.business_meaning: All accounting line items. koart: D=customer, K=vendor, S=GL, M=material, A=asset. Use for GL analysis, vendor spend (WHERE koart='K'), customer revenue (WHERE koart='D'), cost by cost center/profit center.
BSEG.sql_hints: BSEG: dmbtr/wrbtr = amount. Filter koart = 'K' for vendor, 'D' for customer. SUM(dmbtr) GROUP BY hkont (GL), kunnr, lifnr, kostl, prctr, aufnr, matnr, vbeln. Join KNA1 on kunnr, LFA1 on lifnr for names.

CEPC.description: Profit center master data (SAP PCA). A profit center is a business unit, product line, or region whose profit and cost are tracked separately.
CEPC.business_meaning: Profit center master. Use for revenue/cost by business unit, organizational structure, reporting by segment/region/company code.
example_questions: Which profit centers generate most cost?
CEPC.sql_hints: CEPC: prctr = profit center ID, name1 = profit center name, segment = reporting segment, verak = responsible. GROUP BY bukrs, segment, land1, verak for reporting. Profit center costs: BSEG c JOIN CEPC p ON c.prctr = p.prctr, SUM(c.dmbtr) AS total_cost GROUP BY c.prctr, p.name1 ORDER BY total_cost DESC.

CKMLCR.description: Material ledger cost records (CO-PC). Material ledger values and cost differences per period; actual costing data for materials.
CKMLCR.business_meaning: Material valuation, price differences, inventory cost adjustments. Join CKMLHD on kalnr for matnr, plant, vendor.
CKMLCR.sql_hints: CKMLCR: salk3 = inventory value, stprs = standard price, pvprs = periodic unit price. SUM(salk3) for totals. CRITICAL: no matnr column – must join CKMLHD on kalnr to get matnr. Inventory value by material: CKMLCR c JOIN CKMLHD h ON c.kalnr = h.kalnr, SUM(c.salk3) AS inventory_value GROUP BY h.matnr.

CKMLHD.description: Material ledger header (CO-PC). Master information linking material ledger records to materials, plants, and vendors. Primary key: kalnr.
CKMLHD.business_meaning: Material ledger master. Join CKMLCR for values (salk3), CKMLPP for quantities. Use to get inventory value or stock by material (matnr), plant (bwkey), vendor (lifnr).
CKMLHD.sql_hints: CKMLHD: kalnr links to CKMLCR (values: salk3, stprs) and CKMLPP (quantities). Join chain: CKMLHD → CKMLCR or CKMLPP on kalnr. Essential bridge to get matnr from CKMLCR.

EKPO.description: Purchase order items. Line items of purchase orders (material, quantity, unit price, total value, plant, storage location).
EKPO.business_meaning: PO line items. netwr = total value. Join EKKO on ebeln for vendor, company. Use for purchase totals, by material, by plant, top vendors by value.
EKPO.sql_hints: EKPO: netwr = line value, netpr = unit price. SUM(netwr) for total purchases. GROUP BY matnr, werks. Join EKKO on ebeln for lifnr, then SUM(p.netwr) GROUP BY e.lifnr for purchase by vendor.

FAGLFLEXA.description: General ledger line items (SAP New GL). Actual financial postings at line-item level for GL reporting, profit center, cost center, and segment analysis.
FAGLFLEXA.business_meaning: New GL actual postings. hsl = amount in local currency (primary for aggregation). drcrk: S=debit, H=credit. Use for GL balance by account (racct), profit center P&L (prctr), cost center expenses (rcntr).
FAGLFLEXA.sql_hints: FAGLFLEXA: SUM(hsl) for totals; consider drcrk (S=debit, H=credit) for signed balance. GROUP BY racct, prctr, rcntr, rbukrs, poper, gjahr. Join CEPC on prctr for profit center name. To link costs to customers/products: (1) Join VBRP on prctr (VBRP has prctr, matnr; VBRK has kunag) — aggregate FAGLFLEXA by prctr, join to VBRP/VBRK/KNA1/MAKT for customer and product; (2) Or join BSEG on rbukrs=bukrs, belnr, gjahr when BSEG has kunnr/matnr on same document.

KNA1.description: Customer master (general data). Name, country, address, industry, language.
KNA1.business_meaning: Customer master. Join KNVV for sales area data; KNVP for partner functions (sold-to, bill-to, ship-to, payer). Use for customer list, by country, by industry.
KNA1.sql_hints: KNA1: kunnr = customer. GROUP BY land1, brsch for country/industry. Join KNVV on kunnr for vkorg, vtweg, spart; KNVP for parvw (AG/RE/WE/RG). Use T016T on brsch for industry text (brtxt).

KONV.description: Pricing conditions. Condition records used in sales pricing (base price, discounts, tax). Linked via knumv to billing (VBRK) or sales order (VBAK).
KONV.business_meaning: Pricing condition lines. kschl: PR00=base price, K007=discount, MWST=tax. kwert = condition value. Join VBRK or VBAK on knumv for document header.
KONV.sql_hints: KONV: Filter kschl = 'K007' for discounts; SUM(kwert) for condition value. GROUP BY kschl for pricing by type. Join VBRK on knumv for billing doc, VBAK for order doc.

VBRK.description: Billing document header. Invoice header: invoice number, date, sold-to customer, total value.
VBRK.business_meaning: Billing header. kunag=sold-to customer, fkdat=invoice date, netwr=invoice value. Use for invoice value by customer.
VBRK.sql_hints: VBRK: SUM(netwr) for invoice value. GROUP BY kunag for customer. PREFERRED for 'by customer' queries: use VBRK.KUNAG directly. Join VBRP on vbeln for item-level matnr, netwr; KNA1 on kunag for name1.

VBRP.description: Billing document items. Product-level invoice data: material, billed quantity, value, plant.
VBRP.business_meaning: Billing items. fkimg=billed quantity, netwr=item value. Use for revenue by material, revenue by plant, revenue by profit center.
VBRP.sql_hints: VBRP: SUM(netwr) for revenue, SUM(fkimg) for billed quantity. GROUP BY matnr, werks, prctr. Join VBRK on vbeln for kunag; MAKT on matnr for maktx. VBRP has prctr for profit center; use VBRK.KUNAG for customer. For complaints: filter WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(compreas,'')) != '' and GROUP BY kunag.
